controls.source_trace: Input -> decoding -> query builder -> bound values -> selected fixture data.
controls.controlled_verification: Compare legitimate and inert syntax-changing terms on synthetic records.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Errors or WAF blocks alone do not establish changed interpreter semantics.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Untrusted values remain data; valid punctuation/Unicode keep working.

controls.source_trace: Sort/field/operator/date-part selector -> mapping -> raw ORM or backend API.
controls.controlled_verification: Use permitted and unmapped selectors against a controlled feature.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Value parameterization does not automatically protect identifiers/operators.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Only trusted structural choices reach the interpreter; unsupported choices reject safely.

controls.source_trace: Stored/reflected input -> transforms -> template/DOM sink -> actual context.
controls.controlled_verification: Prove a harmless controlled DOM effect in an isolated account/page.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Reflection as escaped text is not XSS; do not read real session data.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Context-correct handling prevents execution while preserving required text/rich content.

controls.source_trace: Executable selection -> shell/argument API -> option parsing -> invoked operation.
controls.controlled_verification: Use a stub executable or local instrumentation to inspect the argument vector.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Array arguments can still expose dangerous caller-selected options.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Executable/structure and unsafe options remain trusted; data arguments cannot gain command authority.

controls.source_trace: Input -> template/filter construction -> evaluation engine -> output.
controls.controlled_verification: Use inert local sentinel interpretation and a legitimate control.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A delimiter in output is not proof it was evaluated.
controls.remediation_acceptance: External content is rendered as data or handled by a deliberately constrained supported feature.

controls.source_trace: Write/import -> stored value -> background job/report/export -> interpreter.
controls.controlled_verification: Save an inert sentinel then inspect its later consumer in a disposable fixture.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A safe insertion path does not prove safe later interpretation.
controls.remediation_acceptance: All reachable later consumers preserve data/instruction separation.
